notes.title: Joyville on sale!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Joyville 2 is officially announced! The teaser trailer is up on our YouTube channel, and you can watch it right here: https://youtu.be/Kn9kawLzOMo

To celebrate, we're kicking off a massive sale for Joyville on Steam! From December 8th to December 22nd, snag the game at a sweet [b]50% off[/b]. Don't miss out!

Also, we've added 8 languages to the game, so folks from all over the world can enjoy playing in their own language. Cool, right?

Thank you for being with us. Don't forget that we have a Discord server where you can chat with our community and be the first to know about all the news! https://discord.gg/BMSYG8yrS5

Yours, KudPlay Games.

notes.title: Joyville Language Update!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to let you know that Joyville is now available in 9 languages: English, German, French, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, and Japanese!

Now most of you can enjoy the game in your native language!

Thanks for sticking with us! Join our Discord server to stay updated on all the important stuff: https://discord.gg/BMSYG8yrS5
